_comment: Authoritative employment facts and banned claims for davidoncloud.com.
Source of truth is the job-search skill at:
This file is a MIRROR of that source so the site can be checked offline. When the source changes,
update this file in the same commit as the content change. Never edit site copy to disagree with it.

bannedPhrases._note: Unsupported metrics and withdrawn display conventions. Checked across all CMS JSON, both HTML pages, every case study in docs/case-studies, and the resume PDF text. Linking to https://www.theanchorcoach.com as a project source is fine; appending it to the employer line is not.

bannedInExperience._note: Anchor must never read as ongoing, and no generic umbrella entry may sit beside it.

resume._charNote: Em dash (U+2014) is banned as a prose interrupter in resumes. En dash in date ranges is allowed.
resume._eduNote: Education carries degree and institution only; never a year or a date range.

structuralFloors._note: Guards against silently losing content that already exists. Raise these when content is deliberately added; never lower them without saying so.

performance._note: Budgets that keep the homepage fast on mobile. Measured 2026-11-07: before these rules the homepage loaded 3.5MB, with one 838KB photo shown in a 250x175 box. Run python3 scripts/optimize_images.py for any new homepage image.

seo._note: Recruiter-facing discoverability floors. The full legal name must be present and machine-readable.
